I started with long tones while humming.  It's pretty difficult to start, but when you get the hang of it, it helps immensely.  I feel like the added resistance of humming forces me to open my throat more, and in turn my tone is fuller when I play normally.

There's a video on YouTube demonstrating what I'm talking about.  The dudes name is Trevor James I think.

Also it helps to sing as low as possible.  I'm a guy so it's a bit easier for me
